messages:
maria: Quick alert - some tenants reporting 403 on SCIM bulk update. Logs show 'KMS: AccessDenied on Decrypt' and 'saml: missing NameID in assertion' around the same window. Anyone seen this pattern?

kevin: that combination is odd. AccessDenied on decrypt points to key policy change or role permission issue. Missing NameID could be separate, maybe an IdP upgrade. Did we rotate any KMS key policies?

ara: there was a policy tweak last week to reduce cross-account decrypts. Could be a regression for service-account role.

samir: I pulled an example SAML assertion from the failed request - NameID is present but wrapped in encrypted attribute block. If KMS decrypt fails, we won't unwrap the attribute and NameID becomes effectively missing.

jess: customers hit with 403 will be unhappy. Immediate fix? Restore previous key policy or add exception for scim role?

maria: recommend temporary policy exception for scim role + audit. We'll patch the policy to explicitly include scim/runner role for Decrypt and ReEncryptFrom.

kevin: applied policy exception in us-east-1. Monitoring SCIM success rate.

sec-alert-bot: policy change detected: KMS policy updated by kevin at 2025-04-01T14:07:02Z.

maria: SCIM bulk success rate back to normal. Need to run a full audit of key policy changes and test suite to catch this.

ara: follow-ups: - revert to least privilege once we have a validated allowlist of roles - add CI check to fail infra PRs that remove Decrypt for known service roles - run a permission audit for all extid CMKs.

samir: vuln note: accidental removal of decrypt perms could be abused to prevent deprovisioning of revoked accounts. Mark sev3.

jess: I'll prepare comms and let sales know.

kevin: filed INFRA-4781 to add policy tests and INFRA-4782 for key permission audit.

maria: Also let's make sure correlation_id is always set before decrypt attempts so we can trace failing requests even if decryption fails.

ara: good call. starting incident doc. closing when tickets linked. :white_check_mark:
